mechanism_narrative: ERBB2+FGFR2 forced-proximity via flexible_GS4 linker (~20 Å) biases signaling toward GRB2/SHC1/FRS2/GAB1/PIK3R1 transphosphorylation adaptors, activating MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT pathways while sterically excluding PLCγ. The biased output upregulates muscle structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOM2, TAGLN, MYL6, TPM2, NOTCH3) and suppresses aged immediate-early genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN, OTUD1, TXNIP, IL32, MYF5, MYH9), mirroring the H2F exemplar pattern and the validated ERBB2+FGFR2 GS_med win.
